description: Submit a resume tailoring job. Call klevercv_list_resumes to pick a resume_id and klevercv_list_templates for a template_id first. Returns a generation_id immediately — do not wait here. Then call klevercv_get_generation_status with the generation_id to retrieve the PDF URL. Errors: RESUME_NOT_FOUND, TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS, INVALID_API_KEY.

company_name.description: Company name (optional). Used for generation history labeling.

job_description.description: Full job description text. Minimum 50 characters.

job_title.description: Job title (optional). Used for generation history labeling.

resume_id.description: Resume ID from klevercv_list_resumes. Currently uses your latest uploaded base resume.

name: klevercv_generate_resume
